task: Estimate the actual productivity ratio of a garment-production team using the supplied production-context measurements.
context: date: calendar date; quarter: source within-month segment, not a calendar quarter; department: production department; team: categorical team number; targeted_productivity: management target ratio; smv: standard minutes allocated to a task; wip: unfinished-item count; over_time: team overtime minutes; no_of_style_change: style-change count; no_of_workers: recorded staffing quantity, which may be fractional. This is a retrospective conditional estimate, not a guaranteed pre-shift forecast. The target can exceed 1 in the observed source records.
